document.abstract: This standard specifies the mapping of VC-5 image essence as a picture essence track of the MXF generic container in frame-wrapped, clip-wrapped, or custom-wrapped form. This standard includes the KLV coding, essence container label values, and compression label values. This standard also defines the subdescriptors for CDCI and Bayer images.
